title: Member deletion left orphaned split IDs corrupting settlement balance math
description: When a member was removed from a trip, their ID remained in expenses.splitMemberIds and expenses.paidBy, producing unequal share totals and persistent split error warnings.
reproSteps: Create trip with 3 members and an equal split expense
Observe warning: 'A split member was removed — update the split'
expectedBehavior: Deleted members are purged automatically from future share calculations.
actualBehavior: Balances calculations broke due to missing member in members dictionary.

diagnostics.stackTrace: settlement.ts:74 members[mId].name threw TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined

resolutionNote: Added automated exclusion of deleted members in App.tsx and settlement engine, redistributing equal shares automatically.

title: iOS build failure due to Capacitor SPM Swift API mismatch on Xcode 16
description: Xcode SPM failed to compile @capacitor/core and plugins because capacitor-swift-pm versions drifted from core Capacitor 8.2.0 API signatures.
reproSteps: Observe compilation error: Cannot find 'CAPPluginCall' in scope
expectedBehavior: iOS project compiles cleanly across Xcode 16 and CI.
actualBehavior: Swift compiler failed due to version mismatch in Package.resolved.

diagnostics.stackTrace: Swift compiler error: Type 'Capacitor' has no member 'Plugins' (SPM version mismatch)

resolutionNote: Pinned capacitor-swift-pm to 8.2.0, committed Package.resolved, and created scripts/align-spm-versions.mjs.

title: Android crash on startup due to uninitialized FirebaseApp in FCM plugin
description: @capacitor/push-notifications crashed on Android launch with IllegalStateException when google-services.json was missing or improperly registered in build.gradle.
reproSteps: Launch app on physical Android device
Observe immediate crash before splash screen
expectedBehavior: App launches cleanly with graceful notification registration.
actualBehavior: Fatal crash with java.lang.IllegalStateException: Default FirebaseApp is not initialized.

diagnostics.stackTrace: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.triptracker.app

resolutionNote: Added google-services.json template and Gradle google-services plugin configuration.

title: Sole Admin account deletion caused orphaned trips with no administrative control
description: A trip admin was able to delete their own account even when no other Google-linked admin existed on the trip, leaving the trip completely unmanageable.
reproSteps: Log in as creator of a trip with 2 unlinked companion members
Delete creator profile from Members list
expectedBehavior: System prevents self-deletion if no other Google-linked admin is present.
actualBehavior: Admin was deleted, leaving orphaned unmanageable trip.

diagnostics.stackTrace: MembersGroupsTab.tsx handleDeleteMember executed without sole-admin guard

resolutionNote: Implemented sole-admin deletion protection requiring at least one other Google-linked Admin before removing an admin account.

title: Native Google OAuth deep link failed on Android auth code exchange
description: Android intent filter was restricted to token callbacks and dropped OAuth authorization code redirects from Chrome Custom Tabs.
reproSteps: Tap 'Sign in with Google' on Android native build
Complete login in Google Chrome Custom Tab
Redirect returns to app but user remains unauthenticated
expectedBehavior: App intercepts deep link, exchanges authorization code for session, and routes to dashboard.
actualBehavior: App reopened at /login with unhandled deep link.

diagnostics.stackTrace: AndroidManifest.xml intent-filter missed scheme host pattern for auth/callback

resolutionNote: Broadened AndroidManifest.xml intent filter and updated parseNativeAuthCallback to support both code and token URL formats.

title: Mobile Safari 100vh caused bottom navigation and toasts to be obscured
description: Static 100vh layout did not account for iOS Safari's dynamic URL bar and home indicator, clipping bottom navigation tabs and action sheets.
reproSteps: Open app in Mobile Safari on iPhone
Scroll down so Safari address bar expands/contracts
Observe bottom navigation bar partially hidden under bottom browser toolbar
expectedBehavior: Bottom bar remains fully visible above iOS safe area and toolbars.
actualBehavior: Bottom tabs clipped behind Safari browser controls.

diagnostics.stackTrace: CSS 100vh static viewport calculation without dynamic viewport units

resolutionNote: Applied CSS 100dvh units with -webkit-fill-available fallbacks and env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding.

title: Hardware swipe-back gesture blocked by scroll-lock touch-action
description: On Android and mobile web, the CSS touch-action: none on the root container prevented the native browser swipe-back gesture from firing.
reproSteps: Open any trip on an Android mobile device
Attempt to swipe from the left edge of the screen to go back
Observe that the swipe gesture is unresponsive
expectedBehavior: Native swipe-back navigates back to previous screen smoothly.
actualBehavior: Swipe gesture was swallowed by touch-action: none.

diagnostics.stackTrace: N/A - CSS styling constraint

resolutionNote: Fixed in commit by scoping touch-action to individual swipeable rows instead of whole viewport.

title: Expense geotagging wrote place names to database violating coordinates-only rule
description: Expense form location tagging persisted location.placeName into Supabase, which violated the database contract requiring coordinates only.
reproSteps: Add an expense and tag current GPS location
expectedBehavior: Database stores only { lat, lng } coordinates; placeName is resolved on client.
actualBehavior: Full Nominatim reverse-geocoded placeName was stored in DB.

diagnostics.stackTrace: tripApi.ts sent raw location object containing placeName string to Supabase

resolutionNote: Added coordsOnly() sanitizer in tripApi.ts and ran DB migration 0043 to scrub historical placeName strings.

title: Back navigation used same-URL pushState causing history loops
description: useHistoryBack pushed duplicate entries on identical URLs, causing back-button presses to trigger unexpected state loops rather than popping modal screens.
reproSteps: Press the browser Back button repeatedly
Observe history gets trapped in same URL
expectedBehavior: Each back button press cleanly pops one layer of UI state.
actualBehavior: Repeated back presses looped on the same screen.

diagnostics.stackTrace: useHistoryBack.ts:18 history.pushState called without unique hash delimiter

resolutionNote: Converted useHistoryBack to push unique hash fragment URLs, creating unambiguous stack entries.

title: Multiple modal sheets closed together on a single back press
description: When an expense review modal opened on top of the expense list within a trip, pressing back dismissed both the modal and the active trip view.
reproSteps: Tap an expense to open ExpenseReviewModal
expectedBehavior: Only the ExpenseReviewModal closes, leaving the active trip open.
actualBehavior: Both the modal closed and the trip was deselected back to TripsListScreen.

diagnostics.stackTrace: App.tsx back listeners fired concurrently without LIFO depth check

resolutionNote: Ordered useHistoryBack invocations to enforce LIFO stack popping.

title: Browser reload while offline wiped visible trip and expense data
description: Zustand store held trip, member, and expense records in volatile memory only. Reloading the browser while offline caused initialize() to catch a network error and leave UI empty.
reproSteps: Observe expense list is completely empty and sync backlog count increases on re-adds
expectedBehavior: All trip data rehydrates instantly from local storage on reload, online or offline.
actualBehavior: In-memory state was wiped to empty arrays, appearing as total data loss.

diagnostics.stackTrace: tripStore.ts:369 initialize() caught offline error and reset store arrays to []

resolutionNote: Wrapped useTripStore with zustand persist middleware backed by localStorage with mergeServerExpenses dirty-state reconciliation.

title: Offline-captured receipt photos caused localStorage QuotaExceededError
description: Large base64-encoded receipt photos captured while offline filled localStorage beyond the 5MB browser quota.
reproSteps: Capture 3 high-resolution receipt images in expense forms
expectedBehavior: Receipt photos stage safely offline without exceeding quota.
actualBehavior: localStorage threw QuotaExceededError and dropped subsequent writes.

diagnostics.stackTrace: DOMException: Failed to execute 'setItem' on 'Storage': Setting the value of 'trip_tracker_state' exceeded the quota.

resolutionNote: Created dedicated IndexedDB store (offlineReceiptStore.ts) to hold offline photos separately from localStorage state.

title: Offline/online toggle briefly signed the user out, flashing login screen
description: Supabase GoTrue client fired onAuthStateChange with a null session whenever token refresh failed during a momentary offline blip, causing RequireAuth to unmount the entire app and redirect to /login.
reproSteps: Toggle network offline in Chrome DevTools
Observe that the app immediately unmounts and redirects to the login screen
expectedBehavior: The user stays authenticated offline with cached credentials.
actualBehavior: Transient null sessions triggered full sign-out redirect.

diagnostics.stackTrace: RequireAuth.tsx:21 Navigate to /login (session was null on TOKEN_REFRESHED failure)

resolutionNote: Updated authStore.ts onAuthStateChange to ignore transient null sessions unless event is explicitly SIGNED_OUT.

title: Member deletion, update, and archiving lacked offline queue support
description: deleteMember, updateMember, and toggleArchiveMember directly called Supabase APIs with no optimistic local updates or offline queueing, throwing network errors when disconnected.
reproSteps: Navigate to Members tab and edit or delete a member
Observe action fails with uncaught network exception
expectedBehavior: Member edits apply optimistically and queue for background sync upon reconnection.
actualBehavior: Network error thrown and local state reverted.

diagnostics.stackTrace: TypeError: Failed to fetch at deleteMemberRow (tripApi.ts:182)

resolutionNote: Implemented full offline-first mutation handlers in tripStore.ts with queueSync actions (deleteMember, updateMember, toggleArchiveMember).

title: Creating a new trip while offline silently failed without offline path
description: createTrip attempted immediate Supabase relational graph insertion without generating local temporary trip entities or persisting them to offline storage.
reproSteps: Tap '+ New Trip', enter details and submit
Observe that new trip never appears in the list
expectedBehavior: Trip is created with local ID, auto-selected, and queued for server sync.
actualBehavior: Operation aborted on network failure with no offline fallback.

diagnostics.stackTrace: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource at insertTripGraph (tripApi.ts:112)

resolutionNote: Added offline createTrip branch in tripStore.ts generating temp trip IDs and queuing createTrip mutations.

title: Superadmin Bug Tracker falsely blocked access when opened from home screen
description: Bug tracker console evaluated isAdmin strictly against activeTrip.ownerId / adminMemberIds; when opened from home screen where activeTrip is null, isAdmin was false and blocked access.
reproSteps: Click the '🛡️ Bug Tracker' button in the top header
expectedBehavior: Bug tracker console opens immediately for developers, superadmins, and QA testing.
actualBehavior: False access denied screen was rendered.

diagnostics.stackTrace: SuperAdminBugTracker.tsx:230 if (!isAdmin) blocked render because activeTrip was null

resolutionNote: Removed artificial trip-scoped lock in SuperAdminBugTracker.tsx and App.tsx, opening direct access to developers.

title: Report a Problem submit fails for normal users (RLS blocked)
description: Report a Problem in Settings could not submit for normal (non-superadmin) users. The RLS policy only grants SELECT on bugs to superadmins, but createBug() computed the next BUG-XXX id via a SELECT and read the inserted row back via .select().single() -- both silently failed for normal users, causing every submission to collide on BUG-001 or return nothing.
expectedBehavior: Report submits and appears in the superadmin bug tracker
actualBehavior: Submission fails silently / never appears in bug tracker
resolutionNote: Fixed via report_bug() SECURITY DEFINER RPC (migration 0059): id computation and insert now run server-side, bypassing RLS, so normal users no longer need SELECT on bugs. bugApi.ts createBug() now calls supabase.rpc('report_bug', ...). Commit 496306b.

title: Report a Problem popup traps scroll, cannot scroll back up to close
description: Report a Problem opened as a modal overlay/popup. On longer forms, scrolling down inside the sheet made it impossible to scroll back up to reach the close (X) button, effectively trapping the user in the modal.
expectedBehavior: User can scroll freely and always reach a way to close/go back
actualBehavior: Scrolling down gets stuck, close button becomes unreachable
resolutionNote: BugReportModal converted from a modal-overlay popup to a full-screen SettingsView subscreen (settings-subscreen-enter layout), same pattern as other Settings subscreens -- no more trapped scroll. Commit 496306b.

title: Report a Problem back navigation discards unsent draft without confirmation
description: Pressing back (on-screen or hardware/browser back) while a Report a Problem draft had unsent content silently discarded it with no confirmation. Expected a 3-way choice: submit and go back, discard and go back, or keep editing.
expectedBehavior: Prompted to submit, discard, or keep editing before leaving
actualBehavior: Draft is silently discarded, no prompt
resolutionNote: Added a back-guard (onRegisterBackGuard) wired through both the on-screen back link and SettingsView's useHistoryBack hardware/browser-back handling. When there's unsent text, a 3-way ConfirmDialog (new tertiaryLabel/onTertiary support) offers Submit & Go Back, Discard & Go Back, or Keep Editing. Commit 496306b.

resolutionNote: Gated the banner on isWebNotificationSupported() in NotificationsPanel.tsx so it only renders in an actual browser tab. Commit 4433bc1.

title: 'Out of sync (0)' status permanently shown on every trip
description: Sync status pill showed 'Out of sync (0)' on every trip, on both web and the native app, even with an empty sync queue. Caused by a second, broken staleness check (lastModifiedAt vs lastBackendSyncedAt) alongside the correct syncQueue.length check.
resolutionNote: Dropped the broken lastModifiedAt/lastBackendSyncedAt comparison from syncStatus in App.tsx -- syncQueue.length is the correct, live signal and was already there. Commit f950404.

title: Superadmin Ops Deck section tabs unusable on mobile
description: Section nav (Flags/Analytics/Trips/Users/Audit/Tools) was a horizontal-scroll pill row on mobile, cutting off tabs with no indication more existed. A follow-up wrapping-grid attempt was also rejected. Resolved with a header-switcher pattern (tap current section, full-screen list opens) after a design-skill review.
resolutionNote: Replaced with a header status-line trigger that opens a full-screen section switcher on tap, reusing the existing dot+code+label rail styling. Also fixed a CSS source-order bug where the desktop rail's unconditional display:flex was overriding its own mobile display:none. Commits 55ab403, 178a638.

title: Ops Deck header rendered under the Android status bar
description: Superadmin Ops Deck header sat flush against the native Android status bar/notification icons -- ops-deck.css never adopted the app-wide env(safe-area-inset-*) padding convention every other screen uses.
resolutionNote: Added the app-wide calc(Npx + var(--safe-top, 0px)) safe-area padding convention to .ops-shell and .ops-panel in ops-deck.css. Commit e433fa8.

title: Feature flags (Flags tab) never reached other devices
description: Toggling a flag, per-trip override, or per-member override in the superadmin Ops Deck only ever updated that browser's local storage -- it never reached Supabase, so no other device (including the traveler's phone) ever saw the change.
resolutionNote: Migration 0064: feature_flag_overrides table (scope: global/trip/user) + get_resolved_feature_flags/get_all_feature_flag_overrides/set_feature_flag_override RPCs. tripStore.ts now persists and loads flags from Supabase instead of local-only zustand persist state. Commit 6fb9e57.

title: Superadmin/demo account shows duplicate categories in Tools tab and expense auto-tagging
description: loadDemoTrip's offline fallback set result.categories to the full DEFAULT_CATEGORIES list, but the caller (tripStore.ts) always does [...DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, ...result.categories] on top -- the online path (insertTripGraph) only ever returns custom categories, so this only broke the fallback taken by the superadmin/demo-user account (insertTripGraph fails for that fake user id). Every default category appeared twice, in AdminToolsPage's brand-keyword/auto-tagging category list and in ExpenseForm's category picker, since both read the same categories store state.
resolutionNote: tripStore.ts loadDemoTrip offline-fallback: result.categories now returns [] (matching insertTripGraph's success-path shape of custom-only categories) instead of DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, so the caller's [...DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, ...result.categories] no longer doubles every default category. Added regression test in tripStore.test.ts (loadDemoTrip suite) that mocks insertTripGraph to reject and asserts categories has no duplicate ids -- fails without the fix (12 ids instead of 6), passes with it.

title: Geotag Expenses toggle in Settings also flipped superadmin master flag, hiding the row
description: Toggling the Geotag Expenses switch in Settings called setEnableGeotagging, which wrote the value into both the trip-level enableGeotagging setting AND featureFlags.enableGeotagging (the superadmin-controlled master flag). Turning it off in Settings therefore also disabled the global feature flag, so the row's own visibility check (isSuperadmin || isFeatureEnabled('enableGeotagging')) went false for non-admin users and the option disappeared from Settings entirely.
expectedBehavior: The Geotag Expenses row's visibility in Settings is controlled only by the superadmin master flag. Switching the user's own toggle on/off never affects whether the row is shown; superadmins always see it.
actualBehavior: setEnableGeotagging in src/store/tripStore.ts wrote to both enableGeotagging and featureFlags.enableGeotagging, so a non-admin switching it off lost the row (and the ability to switch it back on) until an admin re-enabled the master flag.
resolutionNote: src/store/tripStore.ts setEnableGeotagging now only sets the trip-level enableGeotagging value, never touches featureFlags. Master flag stays under exclusive control of setFeatureFlag (superadmin).

title: No way to add multiple trip members in one go without re-tapping the FAB each time
description: After the New Member popup correctly started closing on a successful add (commit cfee4b0), adding several members in a row required tapping the + FAB, filling the form, submitting, then repeating the whole open/fill/submit cycle for every single member -- no in-popup way to keep adding without leaving and reopening it.
expectedBehavior: User can add several new members back-to-back from the same open popup instead of reopening it via the FAB for every name.
actualBehavior: New Member form always closed after a successful add (or, before cfee4b0, never closed at all) -- there was no option to keep it open for a rapid follow-up add.
resolutionNote: src/components/MembersGroupsTab.tsx: added an 'Add another after this one' checkbox to the New Member form (hidden in edit mode). Unchecked (default) keeps existing close-after-add behavior; checked keeps the popup open, clears the fields, and refocuses the name input so the next member can be typed immediately.

title: Members tab had duplicate add-member entry point and redundant Edit/Delete buttons after swipe actions shipped
description: After swipe-to-edit/delete landed on Members tab rows (reusing SwipeableRow), two redundant controls remained: (1) an in-page '+ Add Member' header button duplicating the bottom-nav FAB, giving two entry points for the same action, and (2) explicit Edit/Delete icon buttons on every row now duplicating the swipe gesture on touch devices, cluttering the row.
expectedBehavior: One entry point for adding a member (the bottom-nav FAB). On touch, edit/delete happen via swipe; no redundant icon buttons cluttering the row.
actualBehavior: MembersGroupsTab.tsx rendered both a '+ Add Member' button in the section header and per-row Edit/Delete icon buttons unconditionally, even after swipe actions covered the same actions on touch.
resolutionNote: MembersGroupsTab.tsx: removed the header '+ Add Member' button (FAB is now the sole entry point). Wrapped the per-row Edit/Delete buttons in .member-row-desktop-actions, hidden on touch via the same (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) CSS pattern as .cmd-k-hint -- kept visible for mouse/trackpad users who have no swipe gesture.

title: Production build broken: nullable userId passed to fetchMutedTripIds
description: tripStore.ts initialize() called fetchMutedTripIds(userId) where userId is typed string | null (from session?.user?.id ?? null), but fetchMutedTripIds requires a string. tsc -b (the build script's actual typecheck, run via 'npm run build') caught this even though a plain 'npx tsc --noEmit' during development did not, so both GitHub Pages and EC2 deploy workflows failed on the pushed commit.
expectedBehavior: npm run build succeeds; muted-trip-ids are only fetched when a real signed-in userId exists.
actualBehavior: Build failed with TS2345 at tripStore.ts:636, blocking both GitHub Actions deploy workflows (Pages and EC2) on commit b6ef029.
resolutionNote: tripStore.ts: wrapped the fetchMutedTripIds call in an if (userId) guard, skipping the mute-ids fetch when there's no signed-in user instead of passing a possibly-null value. Commit da7c912.

title: Advanced expense filters were hidden behind an undiscoverable gesture with no back navigation
description: The expense list's advanced filters (amount range, relation, etc.) only surfaced via an undocumented pull-to-reveal gesture with zero visual affordance, and once opened there was no way back to the Expenses tab short of the OS back button.
resolutionNote: Replaced the pull-reveal gesture with an explicit Filters button opening a visible full-screen drawer (ExpenseFilterDrawer.tsx), wired to useHistoryBack/useEscapeKey so back/Esc closes the drawer and lands back on Expenses.

title: Filter drawer header/close button clipped, cropped to the bottom sheet's bounds
description: ExpenseFilterDrawer was rendered nested inside TripContentSheet, whose .trip-sheet wrapper has overflow:hidden. That clips position:fixed descendants in real browsers regardless of containing-block rules, so the drawer's full-screen backdrop and header (title + close button) got cropped to the sheet's visible bounds, leaving the trip header/map bleeding through above it.
resolutionNote: Lifted the filter drawer's render + open/close state from ExpenseList up to App.tsx, rendering it as a sibling of ExpenseForm/ExpenseReviewModal outside TripContentSheet entirely, matching the pattern those unaffected modals already used.

title: Cross-linking from Analytics into the ledger could land on a stale open filter drawer
description: Tab panes stay mounted (display:none, not unmounted) when switching tabs, so ExpenseList's local filter-drawer open state survived a tab switch. Tapping a category/member in Analytics to jump into the filtered ledger could land on a leftover open drawer instead of the transaction list if one had been left open earlier.
resolutionNote: Filter-drawer open state moved from ExpenseList to App.tsx (same lift as BUG-092); every cross-link handler now explicitly closes it before switching tabs.

title: Expense currency picker was discarded at save, silently corrupting cross-currency totals
description: ExpenseForm let a user pick a non-base currency and previewed a live conversion, but the save payload never included the picked currency and App.tsx hardcoded currency to the trip's base currency. Unless the user explicitly clicked 'Use {base}' first, the raw typed number was saved as-is under the base currency, silently corrupting totalSpent/balances for that expense.
resolutionNote: ExpenseForm.tsx now always converts to base currency at save time (not gated on the button click) and passes the actually-selected currency through; App.tsx's handleSaveExpense uses that instead of hardcoding the trip's base currency.

title: Blind Mode's privacy-blur left every amount illegible/smudged-looking
description: The .privacy-blur CSS filter:blur(5px), toggled by the header eye icon, was left active and blurred amounts across the stat strip, expense rows, Members tab balances, and settlement chips -- reported by the user as text 'smudged and not visible properly'.
resolutionNote: Removed Blind Mode entirely per product decision: deleted privacyStore.ts, the header eye-icon toggle, every formatMaskedAmount/.privacy-blur usage across 8 files, replaced with a plain formatAmount() in utils/currency.ts.

title: Redundant refresh icon duplicated the 'Synced' pill's tap-to-sync action
description: The header carried a separate refresh icon button (pull) alongside the already-clickable 'Synced' status pill (push via processQueue), needlessly crowding the header for functionality the pill could already trigger.
resolutionNote: Removed the standalone refresh icon button; merged its refreshActiveTripExpenses() pull into handleSyncClick() so the 'Synced' pill now does both push (processQueue) and pull in one tap.

title: Donut chart click routes to wrong category filter
description: Category donut arcs used fill=transparent, which is still a painted/hit-testable fill for pointer-events:visiblePainted. Every stacked full-circle arc became fully clickable regardless of its visible stroke, so clicking a slice always resolved to whichever category was painted last, not the one under the cursor.
expectedBehavior: Clicking a category's visible arc/legend routes to the Ledger filtered by that category.
actualBehavior: Clicking any category arc always filtered by the topmost-painted category.
resolutionNote: src/components/AnalyticsTab.tsx: changed the per-category donut arc circle's fill from transparent to none, so only the visible stroke ring is hit-tested.

title: Stat-card labels (Total Spent, Daily Average, Top Category) low contrast
description: The shared --text-muted design token failed WCAG AA contrast (~3:1 light, ~3.4:1 dark) against its surface in both themes, making uppercase stat labels across the Expenses tab and Analytics KPI cards hard to read.
expectedBehavior: Stat labels are clearly legible in both light and dark mode.
actualBehavior: Labels rendered in a washed-out, hard-to-read gray in both themes.
resolutionNote: src/index.css: darkened --text-muted to #6B6E76 (light) and lightened to #8B8E96 (dark, both the media-query and explicit data-theme blocks), clearing 4.5:1 contrast in both themes. title: Form labels not programmatically associated with inputs; icon-only buttons unnamed; warning/success text and dismiss-button touch targets fail WCAG AA
description: Full WCAG 2.2 audit found: 45+ form fields across 15 files had visually-adjacent <label> text with no htmlFor/id association (screen readers announced nothing on focus) -- BugReportModal, ExpenseForm, FeatureRequestModal, LoginScreen, MembersGroupsTab, ResetPasswordScreen, SettingsView, ShareTripModal, SuperAdminBugTracker, SuperadminAuthModal, TripsListScreen, admin/AdminFlagsPage, admin/AdminToolsPage. resolutionNote: Commit f7503c7: id/htmlFor pairs on 45+ form fields across 15 files, fieldset/legend for button-group labels, aria-label on 3 icon-only dismiss buttons + new .dismiss-glyph-btn (24x24 AA) utility, --color-warning-text/--color-success-text tokens (~4.6-4.8:1) swapped into 5 small-text call sites failing AA contrast in light theme.

title: Demo Mode shows red Storage Error toast and console errors on every load (non-UUID demo IDs hit Supabase sync)
description: Continue in Demo Mode (Local Testing) calls signInAsDemoUser(), which sets a fake session with user.id 'demo-user-superadmin' in authStore only -- it never calls tripStore.setUserIdentity(), so tripStore.state.userId stays null. loadDemoTrip() then falls back to its local-only branch (real Supabase insert fails with no real session) using synthetic non-UUID ids like trip-goa-<timestamp>. Those ids later get swept into the regular background sync and Postgres rejects them: invalid input syntax for type uuid. setError()'s existing isDemo suppression (get().userId === 'demo-user-superadmin') never fires because state.userId was never set to that value -- so every demo session showed a visible red Storage Error toast plus console.error spam instead of the intended silent console.warn.
resolutionNote: Commit d19e36b: loadDemoTrip() now persists userId/userDisplayName (state.userId || effectiveUserId) so setError()'s isDemo suppression actually fires for the demo-mode cold-start path. Verified via Playwright: console.error+red toast before, console.warn+0 toasts after.

title: Expense 'needs review' flag reappears after refresh even after reassigning payer/split away from a deleted member
description: updateExpenseRow() (src/services/tripApi.ts) called .update(payload).eq('id', id) with no .select(), so error was null even when the UPDATE policy's WITH CHECK silently rejected the write (0 rows affected). tripStore.updateExpense() saw no exception, never queued the change via queueSync, so collectDirtyExpenseIds() never marked the expense dirty. On next load, initialize() re-fetches server expenses and mergeServerExpenses() takes the (never actually updated) server row over the local optimistic fix for anything not dirty -- silently reverting the fix, and ExpenseList's needsReview recomputes true again off the stale paidBy/splitMemberIds. Root cause traced to two layers: (1) missing rows-affected check in updateExpenseRow, and (2) the live 'admin or original author can update expenses' RLS policy on public.expenses (migration 0018) had a WITH CHECK requiring a non-admin editor to remain payer or a split member on the new row, asymmetric with its own USING clause -- so a non-admin original author fixing their own expense by reassigning payer/split away from themselves (the normal outcome of removing a deleted member) was permanently blocked, not just transiently.
resolutionNote: Commit 1c9e46d + supabase migration 0071 (applied to production via supabase db push, verified live via pg_policy query). updateExpenseRow() now chains .select('id') and throws on 0-rows-affected so a silently-rejected write correctly stays dirty across refresh. RLS WITH CHECK on expenses UPDATE relaxed to match USING (admin-or-creator), dropping the extra 'must remain payer/split-member' requirement that permanently blocked non-admin authors from reassigning their own expense away from themselves. Regression test in src/services/tripApi.test.ts.

title: Full-app WCAG 2.2 audit: login gate and trip card were fully unreachable by keyboard, plus 4 other a11y failures and 7 UX polish issues
description: A full-app accessibility + visual/UX audit found: the login screen's 'Slide to open ledger' gate (SlideToUnlock.tsx) was a pointer-only div with no role/tabIndex/onKeyDown or click fallback, making the entire login flow unreachable by keyboard, switch, or many screen-reader users; the home screen's front trip card (TripStack.tsx StackCardItem) had the same problem; input placeholder text failed 4.5:1 contrast (opacity: 0.8 on an otherwise-passing color token); the member add/edit dialog (MembersGroupsTab.tsx) was missing the focus trap every other modal in the app has; the admin command-search input had outline: none with no focus-visible replacement; and StickyBalanceBar had a redundant/confusing click handler on a landmark region duplicating a real nested button. Separately, a visual/UX pass found the home screen's cover photo popped in abruptly with no fade, SlideToUnlock's drag math could render the handle off-track on a narrow/cold-start layout, several components hardcoded one-off transition easings instead of reusing existing --ease-* tokens, ExpenseForm duplicated its error message across 3 render sites with fragile conditions, bottom nav tap targets sat right at the 44pt floor, and a handful of labels in AnalyticsTab/BugReportModal were under 12px.
reproSteps: Open the login screen and try to reach 'Slide to open ledger' using only Tab/Enter -- there was no way to focus or activate it
On the home screen, Tab to the front trip card and press Enter -- nothing happened, the only working entry point was the separate 'View all trips' button
Focus any empty input field and compare placeholder text contrast against surrounding body text -- placeholder visibly washed out
expectedBehavior: Every interactive control (login gate, trip card, dialogs, admin search) is operable by keyboard alone and meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast/focus-visibility; UI polish (loading feedback, consistent easing, tap targets, error display) matches the rest of the app's design system.
actualBehavior: Login and home screen were hard keyboard blockers; several modals/controls had missing or inconsistent focus handling and contrast; assorted UX rough edges (abrupt photo pop-in, duplicated error text, tight tap targets).
resolutionNote: Commit 1471c34. SlideToUnlock.tsx: added role=button/tabIndex/onKeyDown (Enter/Space unlocks) and clamped maxDistance to >=0. TripStack.tsx: StackCardItem front card now role=button/tabIndex/onKeyDown, cover photo now fades in via a separate .stack-card-photo layer with a reduced-motion guard instead of an abrupt background-image swap. index.css: placeholder opacity 0.8->1 (text-muted alone already passes 4.5:1), added .stack-card:focus-visible ring, consolidated .filter-chip and .expense-review-banner ad hoc easings to var(--transition-smooth), added .nav-tab-item min-height:48px. MembersGroupsTab.tsx: added useFocusTrap to the add/edit member dialog (skipAutoFocus, Escape deferred to the name-suggestion dropdown's own handler while it's open so the two Escape behaviors don't fight). ops-deck.css: added :focus-visible ring to .ops-cmdk input. StickyBalanceBar.tsx: removed the redundant onClick on the landmark <aside>, kept only the real nested button. ExpenseForm.tsx: replaced 3 independently-duplicated formError conditions with one derived isAmountFormError/isTitleFormError/isGeneralFormError classification so each error renders exactly once. SlideToUnlock.tsx inline easing plus AnalyticsTab.tsx/BugReportModal.tsx sub-12px labels also fixed; contrailFlow's linear animation was reviewed and deliberately left as-is (correct for a continuous dash-flow effect). A broader hardcoded-hex-color sweep was investigated but found no safe targets -- the flagged occurrences were Google's official brand-color SVG paths (LoginScreen.tsx), a Mapbox GL paint property that doesn't accept CSS vars (TripMapHero.tsx), and TripWrappedModal.tsx's deliberate hardcoded light/dark pairs (export/share-card context) -- so left untouched.

title: Superadmin could not delete a user with expense history, even though suspend worked
description: In the Superadmin portal's Users page, suspending a user (setUserBanned) worked, but deleting one (deleteUserAccount -> delete_user RPC) failed with 'This account has expense history and cannot be deleted. Suspend it instead.' The delete_user() function (migration 0068) intentionally raised that exception for any account referenced by expenses.created_by_user_id, since the column was NOT NULL with a plain FK (no cascade) -- a hard delete would otherwise orphan those rows or surface a raw FK violation.
reproSteps: Pick a user who has logged at least one expense
Click Delete and type DELETE to confirm
Observe toast: This account has expense history and cannot be deleted. Suspend it instead.
expectedBehavior: Superadmin can hard-delete a user account that has logged expenses; their past expenses remain intact but lose their creator attribution.
actualBehavior: Delete button in AdminUsersPage always failed for any user who had ever logged an expense, with no way to actually remove the account short of suspending it forever.
resolutionNote: Commit 529558d + supabase migration 0072. expenses.created_by_user_id relaxed to nullable with an ON DELETE SET NULL FK (mirroring members.linked_user_id), and delete_user() no longer raises an exception for accounts with expense history -- deleting the auth.users row now anonymizes (nulls out) authorship on their past expenses instead of being blocked. Expense content is untouched; permission checks comparing created_by_user_id = auth.uid() simply stop matching once null, leaving trip admins as the only ones who can still manage the expense. Also guarded AdminAnalyticsPage's retention-cohort active-user Set against null creator ids.

title: Superadmin Users tab: Suspend/Delete errors were visually indistinguishable from success
description: AdminUsersPage's toast (`.ops-toast`) always rendered with a green checkmark and safe/success styling regardless of whether the message was a success confirmation or a thrown error. Every failure path -- 'Superadmin access required.', 'Cannot suspend/delete a superadmin account.', the (since-fixed) expense-history block, or a network/RLS error -- displayed with the same checkmark, so a failed Suspend or Delete looked identical to a successful one. The same duplicated showToast/.ops-toast pattern with no error state existed in 5 other admin pages (Flags, Trips, Audit, Features, Tools).
reproSteps: Click Suspend or Delete on a user where the RPC will reject (e.g. not currently a superadmin session, or a blocked case)
Observe toast renders with a green checkmark just like a successful action
Refresh the list -- the user's status never actually changed
expectedBehavior: A failed Suspend/Delete shows a visually distinct error toast (red, alert icon) with the real error message, so the admin knows the action did not happen.
actualBehavior: Error and success toasts were styled identically (green check, .ops-toast), making every failure look like a success.
resolutionNote: AdminUsersPage.tsx: showToast(msg, isError) now tracks error state; toast renders IconAlertCircle + red '.ops-toast.error' styling (new class in ops-deck.css using existing --danger tokens) with role="alert" on failure vs IconCheck/role="status" on success. All 4 catch blocks (suspend, bulk suspend, delete, broadcast) now pass isError=true. Verified set_user_banned/delete_user RPCs and is_superadmin() work correctly server-side (no drift between deployed functions and migration files; live-tested set_user_banned in a rolled-back transaction as the actual superadmin). Also discovered and deployed migration 0072 (BUG-109's fix), which was committed to the repo but had never been pushed to production -- schema_migrations tracked 0071 as the latest applied version.

title: Follow-up WCAG 2.2 pass: keyboard traps on trip/notification cards, unlabeled toggles/inputs, window.confirm() in admin, missing headings
description: Follow-up WCAG 2.2 pass: keyboard traps on trip/notification cards, unlabeled toggles/inputs, window.confirm() in admin, missing headings
resolutionNote: Follow-up audit after BUG-111: TripsListScreen trip card, NotificationsPanel card, BoardingPassHeroCard origin/dest edit triggers, and AnalyticsTab category legend rows were div-onClick with no role/tabIndex/keydown -- added keyboard support guarded against double-firing from nested controls. Geotag/Mute toggle switches and the ExpenseForm split-amount input had no accessible name -- added aria-label. UpiPaymentModal/TripWrappedModal close buttons and BoardingPassHeroCard glyph-only submit buttons were icon-only with no name -- added aria-label. AdminPortalLayout critical-bug badge and NotificationsPanel unread dot conveyed state by color alone -- added text-equivalent labels. ExpenseForm and UpiPaymentModal did not close on Escape (useFocusTrap called without onEscape) -- wired it. Replaced all 8 window.confirm()/native-dialog call sites in the admin portal (AdminAuditPage, AdminTripsPage x2, AdminUsersPage x2, AdminToolsPage x2, SuperAdminBugTracker) with the app's ConfirmDialog, adding confirmRequest state + rendering to AdminPortalLayout and threading onRequestConfirm through the 4 admin pages. BalancesSettlements 'Who owes who' was a bare div with no heading in the whole screen -- retagged to h2. ExpenseFilterDrawer group titles skipped h2->h4 -- retagged to h3. Bumped the 20x20 'Why this amount?' button to the 24x24 WCAG 2.5.8 minimum. Added aria-label to unlabeled search/filter/paste inputs in SuperAdminBugTracker and SettingsView. Wired Escape key support into SettingsView's bug-report/feature-request subscreens, reusing their existing unsaved-draft confirm guard so Escape gets the same data-loss protection as hardware/browser back. tsc -b and oxlint both clean after all changes.
